title: The Static Snapshot WordPress plugin through 0.2.1 does not sanitise shell metacharacters in a user-supplied value…
description: The Static Snapshot WordPress plugin up to version 0.2.1 contains a vulnerability where it fails to sanitize shell metacharacters in user-supplied input before using it in operating system commands. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the server hosting the plugin.
